overview_description.description:
BULK is employee rewards infrastructure for companies that run structured, recurring reward programs.

We help HR and Finance teams replace manual reward handling and multiple vendors with one centralized, auditable system. BULK enables companies to plan, issue, and track digital rewards through a single compliant platform and one clear invoice.

Our focus is not one-off gifting, but recurring, controlled reward programs that scale as organizations grow — without spreadsheets, manual distribution, or operational chaos.

BULK exists to make employee rewards predictable, auditable, and operationally reliable.
